chunks: Ahmad ibn al-Hasan al-Qattan narrated that Abdul Rahman ibn Muhammad al-Husayni quoted on the authority of Muhammad ibn Ibrahim ibn Muhammad al-Fazari, on the authority of Abdul Rahman ibn Bahr al-Ahwazi, on the authority of Al-Hasan Ali ibn Amr, on the authority of Al-Hasan ibn Muhammad ibn Jomhoor, on the authority of Ali ibn Bilal, from Ali ibn Musa Ar-Ridha (peace be upon him), from his father, from his forefathers, from Ali ibn Abi Talib (peace be upon him), from the Prophet (peace be upon him and his family), from Gabriel, from Michael, from Israfil, from the Tablet, from the Pen, who said:
God the Exalted the Honorable said: 'The guardianship (Wilayah) of Ali ibn Abi Talib is My Stronghold. Whoever enters My Stronghold is secure from My punishment.'
ai.seo_question: What is the significance of Ali ibn Abi Talib's Wilayah as a fortress in Shia theology?
ai.summary: This hadith qudsi, transmitted through the Imams from the Prophet and ultimately to the Preserved Tablet and Pen, elevates Ali ibn Abi Talib’s Wilayah to a cosmic reality, linking it directly to divine protection. In Shia theology, this 'fortress' (hisn) signifies that adherence to the Imam’s authority is the primary mechanism for salvation, ensuring the believer is shielded from the Fire. The chain’s reference to the Tablet and Pen underscores the eternal, pre-existent nature of this guardianship in the divine decree.

en.dr-ali-peiravi: 38-1 Ahmad ibn Al-Hassan al-Qattan narrated that Abdul Rahman ibn Muhammad Al-Husayni quoted on the authority of Muhammad ibn Ibrahim ibn Muhammad al-Fazari, on the authority of Abdul Rahman ibn Bahr al-Ahwazi, on the authority of Abul Hassan Ali ibn Amr, on the authority of Al-Hassan ibn Muhammad ibn Jomhoor, on the authority of Ali ibn Bilal, on the authority of Ali ibn Musa Ar-Ridha’ (a.s.), on the authority of his father (a.s.), on the authority of his forefathers (a.s.), on the authority of Ali ibn Abi Talib (a.s.), on the authority of the Prophet (S), on the authority of Gabriel, on the authority of Michael, on the authority of Israfil, on the authority of the Tablet, on the authority of the Pen that
God the Exalted the Honorable said, “The friendship with Ali ibn Abi Talib is My Stronghold. Whoever enters My Stronghold is secure from My punishment.”
